findings.finding: The Chen (2021) in-text link reaches the Donna Chen dissertation entry. The headline descriptions agree with the source excerpts and locators in the evidence packet and transcribed tables. The repository copy of the dissertation PDF was unavailable for a fresh page-level check.

E1 is smaller and zero versus nonzero, E2–E3 smaller in the same direction, E4 larger in the same direction, and E5 magnitude and direction are unestablished. Units are stated and tolerances remain .005/.005/.01 percentage points and .0091 rejection rate. The E4 mean digitization error is .00915 before display rounding.

Chen Table 4.8 transcriptions give 12.50–18.75% within .10 for direct effects and the packet attributes the negative-bias finding to the dissertation discussion. All corresponding ours rows are within .05, with the largest absolute bias .0155 before rounding.

findings.finding: Published coverage is 24.10–83.99% with above/below ranges 14.08–75.55% and 0.34–1.93%. Ours coverage range is 94.5944–95.6348% and above/below are 2.5217–2.8974% and 1.8434–2.7070% in table49_ours.csv.
Figure 4.28 read points are .0571 and .0683, with cutoff 1 occluded. Ours reaches .8518 over these two cutoffs, .8361 over all three, and .97 or more for the stated larger effects from n=1,000.
The 5,000 recommendation is tentative in the source excerpts. Ours has explicit 86.3% and 89.2% findings, similar per-cutoff shares, and the conservative both-zero result.

The tentative minimum sample size is a qualitative grid-wide recommendation. The table gives separate Published/Ours findings and a partial scientific verdict while marking each scalar comparison field unestablished.
